panels.description: Arbitrary metric selected from the $metric variable, filtered by container host and region.

panels.description: Per-container user-space CPU utilization.
panels.title: Container CPU User

panels.title: Container CPU Sys

panels.description: Asynchronous memory reclaim latency for all the container (ms).

panels.title: Host kswapd Reclaim Volume (Cumulative)
